contact_scope: K2 combined review (claude/rl-rubber @60e9119, finding K2-1): law v3 is valid for TRANSLATIONAL sliding only (its patch slip-rate equalisation suppresses rotation about the normal and in-plane bending in slip; label contact_slip_rate_equalised outside that scope). Choice for P2-5: the friction experiments F1 / F2 are scoped to straight-line translational sliding with v3 and the restriction is stated: a free symmetric block (no grip, one contact region = the table plane) pushed by a uniform back-face traction along +x through its symmetry plane, so the motion is pure translation by construction. Law v2 is not used: its only formally scored row is n_t 3 (sliding 0.6), while the fit model is n_t 4 and the truth n_t 6 (v2 NOT_ESTABLISHED there). Scope check (declared, reported in the truth receipts and the held-out predictions): max lateral centroid drift and max change of the y spread of the 9 cross-section centroids <= 1e-4 m (1 video sigma); a row above it is labelled OUTSIDE_TRANSLATIONAL_SCOPE. The fitted mu_table is a translational-sliding friction coefficient of law v3 only; it must not be used for spin, sideways drag or multi-region contact (P2-6 friction stays under the K2-1 fallback). Fit box [0.3, 0.8] and prior box [0.4, 0.6] lie inside the v3 translational envelope at n_t 4 (contact_v3_001) and n_t 6 (contact_envelope_v1_001).

resolution_specific: Q1w (K2 review condition 4): every fitted theta is RESOLUTION_SPECIFIC to rubber_ref_v1 (n_t 4, CFL 0.5), which carries the measured wide-strip sag bias Q1w +0.62 % (+0.50 ... +0.78 %; known_limitation rubber_phys_11_v5_q1w_gci_2.16pct). The n_t 6 truth is itself +0.21 % for Q1w, so the discretisation floor b_mk captures only about 0.4 % of the n_t 4 bias, not the whole bias. theta_hat is never carried to n_t 3 or 6 without the bias shift; the fit receipt carries the label.
sealing: The seal is procedural (K2 review, P2-5 additions): the truth is generated and revealed by separate processes; sealed/ lives under artifacts/ (outside the git worktree, on /mnt/data) with mode 0700 / 0400; every read through rubber_calibration_synthetic.reveal is logged in sealed/read_log.txt; the fit / held-out API refuses sealed paths. The fitting agent runs as the same OS user, so CAL-08 detects order violations, not peeking.
statement: Synthetic numerical validation of the calibration interface. The truth is the simulator itself (same model family) at a finer resolution with sensor noise. It is NEVER a calibration: no real rubber data exists on this machine; no recipe is promoted; synthetic manifests can never satisfy the REAL_CALIBRATED gate. Same-family truth cannot reveal model-form error against real rubber; it tests identifiability, the pipeline and generalisation of the declared protocol under discretisation and noise.
